verdict: Yes. Hair Originals pitched hair extensions and wigs made from real human hair on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal from three sharks. India is one of the world's biggest sources of human hair, often from temple donations, and buyers pay well for quality extensions and wigs.
angle: Human hair from India is exported worldwide. Extensions, toppers and wigs sell to women with thinning hair, brides and cancer patients. Quality grading, colour matching and customer support decide success.
